title: Plan class: investigation (shared acceptance invariants)
description: The CLASS rubric investigation-only plans' acceptance rubrics reference (acceptance-rubrics-on-every-plan-2026-08-11 D-006/D-009 — it may stand ALONE, with zero bespoke criteria, for a pure investigation). An investigation is done when its findings are durable, verified at the writer, and turned into addressable decisions. Graded at plan completion by a NON-implementer.

criteria.title: Findings recorded durably, with evidence
criteria.model: Findings live on a durable surface (plan / work-item / insights doc) with their evidence attached — not only in a transcript that scrolls away or compacts.
criteria.method: Locate each headline finding on its durable surface; confirm the evidence (queries, outputs, refs) rides with it.
criteria.driftMarkers: Conclusions that exist only in chat; evidence summarized away to adjectives.

criteria.title: Every reported number verified at its WRITER
criteria.model: Each metric/count/status the investigation reports was verified against the code that WRITES it — units, scale, and semantics — never inferred from a single artifact's name.
criteria.method: Sample the report's load-bearing numbers; for each, find the writer the record cites (file/line or query) and confirm the stated semantics.
criteria.driftMarkers: A suspiciously round rate (0%/99.9%); an absence proven by one grep; a damning conclusion from an unread column.

criteria.title: The resulting ruling is addressable
criteria.model: What the investigation SETTLED is a plan Decision (or a filed, owned work-item) that others can re-read as authority — not a paraphrase in a message.
criteria.method: Find the D-NNN / WI-NNN carrying the ruling; confirm it states the ruling and its grounds.
criteria.driftMarkers: The same dispute reopening in the next lane because the ruling lived in coord chatter.

criteria.title: Actionable discoveries filed, none dropped
criteria.model: Every actionable discovery made along the way — bugs, frictions, workarounds — was filed at the moment of discovery (improvements:capture / work-items); nothing rides only in prose.
criteria.method: Read the investigation's record for mentioned-but-unfiled discoveries; spot-check that named frictions have filed items.
criteria.driftMarkers: 'We should also fix…' sentences with no item behind them; workarounds performed silently.

criteria.title: The independent grader audits the audit
criteria.model: The independent grader opens a sample of the implementer's plan-audit citations and confirms each sampled code/test reference resolves against the current tree and actually supports the audited item — the audit verdict itself is never accepted as proof.
criteria.method: Read the subject plan's effective per-item audit. Spot-check at least one resolving code/test citation (and expand the sample after any mismatch): open the cited current blob, compare it with the item requirement and audit claim, and record what was checked. Treat doc, workitem, and none citations as declarations of non-verification, never substitutes for code truth.
criteria.driftMarkers: A grade copied from the audit's PASS label; no cited blob opened; a stale blob hash ignored; doc/work-item prose treated as proof that code exists.
